nodes.statement: ∀ p : ℕ, 5 ≤ p → p ≤ 20 → Rep2 p → TwinWitness p
nodes.definitions:
def Rep2 (p : ℕ) : Prop := ∃ q₁ q₂ : ℕ, q₁ ≤ p ∧ q₂ ≤ p ∧ Nat.Prime q₁ ∧ Nat.Prime q₂ ∧ (2 : ℤ) = (q₁ : ℤ) - (q₂ : ℤ)

def TwinWitness (p : ℕ) : Prop := ∃ q : ℕ, q ≤ p ∧ Nat.Prime q ∧ Nat.Prime (q + 2) ∧ q + 2 ≤ p
nodes.proof:
by
  intro p hp5 hp20 hrep
  rcases hrep with ⟨q₁, q₂, hq₁le, hq₂le, hq₁prime, hq₂prime, hdiff⟩
  have hq₁eq : q₁ = q₂ + 2 := by
    omega
  refine ⟨q₂, hq₂le, hq₂prime, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← hq₁eq]
    exact hq₁prime
  · omega
